title: 第26章 李铁柱第27章 她是你亲生的
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
三天后。
以朝阳坊为中心，齐源店铺的名气不断的向周围扩散。
导致附近的人就算没去过，也听过黄粱一梦的事情。
哪怕有些人以为这是以讹传讹，但还有一部分按耐不住心中的好奇，打算去看一看。
这一看，就彻底被黄粱一梦所俘获。
回家之后跟家里人不断的说黄粱一梦有多好，多神奇。
刚开始家里人也吓了一跳，还以为是被哪个邪教蛊惑了。
召集人手想要上门看看，然后就跟其他人一样，沉迷黄粱一梦，无法自拔。
要不是每次使用黄粱一梦，对精神有一定的消耗，要休息一段时间才能继续使用。
估计有一些家底富裕的人，都会选择一整天，除了吃喝拉撒，都待在齐源的店里。
哪怕是这样，齐源店铺里面也是人满为患，不断的有人进进出出。
每当有人黄粱一梦使用结束出来，就有一个新来的人进去。
巨大的人流量也带动了朝阳坊其他店铺，生意比平时好上好几倍，现在就连睡觉都是咧开嘴睡的。
每次看见齐源都是满脸笑容的打招呼，听说齐源喜欢吃糕点，还会给齐源塞一些上好的糕点。
几次下来，送的这些糕点都够齐源吃半个月的了，还好上次王二牛来的时候交易了一些野兽，
时不时可以换换口味，不然都快吃反胃了，就是被吸取气血之后，这些野兽肉，都成肉干了，导致吃起来有点柴。
不过没关系，这些肉，齐源很好心的跟店里来的客人分享了。
个个是赞不绝口，什么入口即化、回味无穷的赞美词都说出来了。
此时齐源看着店里众多陷入沉睡的人，感应了下黄粱一梦增长的量，满意的点了点头。
这几天人数多了之后黄粱一梦增长迅速，就是店铺太小了，现在店铺顶多容纳二十多人。

没办法一次性把黄粱一梦最大的量发挥出来，看来要想办法扩大店铺了。
至于扩大之后的人手问题，齐源并不担心，多买几个香炉，把幻梦香提前放进去就好了。
然后哪个客人要入梦，让林若渊把香炉拿过去就可以了。
没错，现在林若渊在齐源这边打杂。
总不能什么事情都齐源自己做，毕竟他还要练武呢。
这几天已经帮林若渊安排好了，白天会在旭日武馆练武，晚上的时候就会在齐源的店铺里面打杂。
齐源并没有第一时间就去招募林若渊，毕竟你要一个人帮你做事，总得有什么东西可以给他的吧。
就像齐源需要石修的武馆帮忙收集妖兽尸体一样，给出的报酬就是问下齐源不存在的师傅，疗伤丹药的事情。
之后抽取到疗伤一类的奇物，齐源自然会帮忙，而且狩猎到的妖兽也都是会付银子的。
就像王二牛他们狩猎野兽，给的就是银子，都是确确实实可以得到的东西。
总不能别人给你做事，还给别人画饼吧，他又不是资本家
能画一次，难道还能一直画下去，这样的话人心就散了，队伍就不好带了。
谁还会死心塌地的帮你做事。
所以齐源在等，等一个合适的时候。
到时候齐源就会跟她做一个公平的交易，她只要献上忠诚，而齐源会帮她变强。
“齐兄弟，好消息啊”
思索间，一道人影从门口进来，定睛一看，是李大海，只是李大海身边还跟着一个三十多岁的壮汉。
齐源不解的问道：“什么好消息？”
李大海哈哈一笑：“从今天开始，朝阳坊跟附近的坊市，都是卧虎帮管辖了。”
“而且，最重要的是，朝阳坊现在是我儿子管的。”

李大海说着目光也看向了跟他一起来的壮汉。
“给你介绍一下，这是我儿子，李铁柱。“”
李铁柱憨憨一笑：“齐掌柜，早就听我爹说起你了，只是一直没什么时间来看看，现在终于见到了，真的是年少有为啊。”
content_en:
Three days later.
With Chaoyangfang as the center, the reputation of Qiyuan Store continues to spread to the surrounding areas.
As a result, people nearby have heard about Huang Liang Yimeng even if they have never been there.
Even though some people thought this was a rumor, there were still some people who couldn't hold back their curiosity and planned to take a look.
At this sight, I was completely captured by Huang Liang's dream.
After returning home, I kept talking to my family about how wonderful Huangliang Yimeng was and how magical it was.
At first, the family was shocked and thought they were bewitched by a cult.
I gathered people to come and have a look, and then I was like everyone else, addicted to Huang Liang's dream and unable to extricate myself.
If it weren't for the fact that every time I use Huangliang Yimeng, it consumes a certain amount of energy, and I have to rest for a while before continuing to use it.
It is estimated that some people from wealthy families will choose to stay in Qiyuan's shop all day long except for eating, drinking and eating.
Even so, Qiyuan's store was still overcrowded, with people constantly coming in and out.
Every time someone comes out after using Huang Liang Yimeng, a new person comes in.
The huge flow of people has also driven other shops in Chaoyangfang, and their business has been several times better than usual. Now they even sleep with their mouths open.
Every time I see Qi Yuan, I greet him with a smile on my face. I heard that Qi Yuan likes to eat cakes, and I will stuff Qi Yuan with some good cakes.
After several visits, the pastries given to Qi Yuan were enough for half a month. Fortunately, when Wang Erniu came last time, he traded some wild animals.
You can change the taste from time to time, otherwise it will almost make you feel nauseous. After the qi and blood are sucked out, the meat of these beasts becomes dried, making it taste a bit bad.
But it doesn't matter, Qi Yuan kindly shared the meat with the customers in the store.
Everyone was full of praise, and they all said words of praise that melted in your mouth and left you with endless aftertaste.
At this time, Qi Yuan looked at the many people sleeping in the store, sensed Huang Liang Yimeng's growth, and nodded with satisfaction.
Huangliang Yimeng has grown rapidly after the number of people has increased in the past few days, but the store is too small. Now the store can only accommodate more than 20 people.
There is no way to maximize the capacity of Huangliang Yimeng at once, so it seems that we have to find a way to expand the store.
As for the manpower problem after the expansion, Qi Yuan is not worried. He can just buy a few more incense burners and put in the Fantasy Incense in advance.
Then if any guest wants to fall asleep, just ask Lin Ruoyuan to take the incense burner.
That's right, Lin Ruoyuan is now doing odd jobs at Qi Yuan's side.
Qi Yuan can't do everything by himself, after all, he still has to practice martial arts.
In the past few days, I have made arrangements for Lin Ruoyuan. During the day, he will practice martial arts at Xuri Martial Arts School, and at night, he will work as a handyman in Qi Yuan's shop.
Qi Yuan did not recruit Lin Ruoyuan immediately. After all, if you want someone to help you, you must have something to give him.
Just like Qi Yuan needed Shi Xiu's martial arts gym to help collect monster corpses, the reward was to ask Qi Yuan's non-existent master about the healing elixir.
After extracting rare items such as healing, Qi Yuan will naturally help, and he will also pay money for the monsters he hunts.
Just like Wang Erniu and the others, they hunted wild animals and gave them money, which was something they could actually get.
You can't let someone else do things for you and then give someone else a cake. He's not a capitalist.
If you can draw once, how can you keep drawing forever? If so, people's hearts will be scattered and it will be difficult to lead the team.
Who will help you with all your heart?
So Qi Yuan is waiting for the right time.
When the time comes, Qi Yuan will make a fair deal with her. She only needs to offer her loyalty, and Qi Yuan will help her become stronger.
"Brother Qi, good news"
While thinking about it, a figure came in from the door. After a closer look, it was Li Dahai, but there was a strong man in his thirties accompanying Li Dahai.
Qi Yuan asked in confusion: "What's the good news?"
Li Dahai laughed: "From today on, Chaoyangfang and nearby Fangshi will be under the jurisdiction of the Crouching Tiger Gang. "
“And, most importantly, Chaoyangfang is now in charge of my son. "
Li Dahai said and looked at the strong man who came with him.
"Let me introduce you, this is my son, Li Tiezhu. ""
Li Tiezhu smiled naively: "Shopkeeper Qi, I have heard my father talk about you for a long time, but I never had time to come and see you. Now I finally see you. You are really young and promising."
